title: Riverdale (American TV series)
production_companies: CBS StudiosCredited as CBS Television Studios for seasons 1–4
premise_summary: Riverdale is an American television series based on the characters of Archie Comics. The series was adapted for the CW Network by Archie Comics' chief creative officer Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa. It is produced by Warner Bros. Television and CBS Studios, in association with Berlanti Productions and Archie Comics.
